Payload.$Comment: Mob scaling is switched off entirely in this instance. The contains pattern reaches a live instance world (named instance-<Name>-<uuid>, so the token sits mid-name), and the trailing '-' inside it is the delimiter the engine puts between the instance name and its id: with it, this pattern matches Dungeon of Fear II alone, never III, whose name merely begins the same way. Add "GameplayConfig": ["YourKey"] beside the pattern if your instance authors one - that axis outranks every name pattern and never changes when the instance is rebuilt. PlayerScalingStartRingBlocks is pinned to 0 so that an owner who flips Enabled back on gets the player/group delta from the first block, instead of the global newcomer ring around world spawn suppressing it.
